title: THE BEER VALLEY Chindi Woven Rug 2x3 Feet - Yellow
features: HANDWOVEN COTTON CHINDI RUG: Crafted handwoven from recycled cotton fabric strips, this chindi rag rug features a textured braided weave that adds authentic artisan craftsmanship to your home. The soft cotton fibres create a comfortable surface underfoot while maintaining durability for everyday use.

ACCENT RUG SIZE: Measuring approximately 2 x 3 feet (24 x 36 inches), this compact area rug fits perfectly in entryways, kitchens, bedrooms, laundry rooms, and hallways. A great decorative accent rug for doorways, bedside areas, or small furniture spaces.

DOUBLE-SIDED DESIGN: Designed with a durable reversible weave, this rug can be flipped and used on both sides for extended life. The double-sided construction helps maintain its appearance even in high-traffic indoor spaces. Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, nurseries, entryways, and office spaces. This decorative cotton rug provides comfort while protecting floors from scratches and daily wear.

BOHO HOME DÉCOR: The colorful chindi pattern complements farmhouse, bohemian, rustic, and modern interiors. It adds warmth, texture, and character while enhancing the overall décor of your living space.

EASY TO MAINTAIN: Crafted from breathable cotton fibres, this rug is lightweight and easy to move around your home. It can be vacuumed or gently machine washed to keep it fresh and clean for everyday use.
